source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/no-risk; scans all host buses and treats address presence as cable validation despite unknown endpoints.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with endpoint topology, but still does not decide whether coverage means logical reachability, assembly, continuity or signal integrity.
source_snapshot.historical_v3_1: BLOCKED because cable PN/revision/endpoints/pinout and the fundamental logical-versus-physical/electrical test objective, thresholds and recovery are absent.

old_problem: A cable is an interconnect, not an I2C address. The source does not identify the harness or whether the intended proof is endpoint reachability, correct assembly/pinout, pin continuity, intermittent-contact detection or signal margin. DeepSeek's global scan maps no responder to this harness and could touch unrelated bridged devices.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. Logical reachability, physical inspection, continuity and signal-integrity testing prove different properties and require different power states, instruments, safety controls and acceptance thresholds. ED-09 also reserves physical cable actions for humans. Choosing one modality without the harness specification would invent and potentially reduce coverage.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1808, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1809 / Wistron-HW-00011-V003 / 63582d1f5105f068.
A downstream response demonstrates only momentary logical reachability through some conductors; it does not prove every pin, connector seating, routing or signal margin.
Continuity or physical inspection likewise does not prove protocol ownership and response correctness, so required checkpoints must be specified separately.
ED-09 assigns physical cable handling and inspection to qualified humans; ED-03 forbids guessed OEM endpoints, and ED-15 requires approved thresholds.
Any future active probe must use the exact BMC/OOB route and safe endpoint allowlist; any continuity/signal measurement needs an approved isolated state and instrument method.
No SSH, I2C, cable manipulation, continuity, signal measurement, scan, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: I2C cable/harness logical, physical and electrical validation — blocked pending coverage decision
test_case.purpose: Preserve I2C cable coverage and, after owner definition, independently verify every required logical-reachability, physical-assembly/pinout, continuity and/or signal-integrity checkpoint for the exact harness without conflating their evidence.
required_package: Exact cable/harness part number, revision, length/routing, source/destination boards/connectors and pinout
Owner decision listing required logical, physical, continuity and signal-integrity checkpoints separately
For logical checks: BMC/OOB controller/mux/bus/address/device map, safe transaction and expected responses
For physical/electrical checks: approved power/isolation state, human procedure, instruments/probes and numeric thresholds
Endpoint health monitoring, maintenance authorization, evidence plan and recovery independent of the path under test
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no bus or physical cable action. After the harness and coverage contract receive fresh review, execute only approved checkpoints: bounded endpoint-specific BMC/OOB reads for logical continuity; qualified-human visual/reseat work only when explicitly required; and pin-to-pin or signal-integrity measurements only in the approved isolated state with specified instruments. Capture each checkpoint independently with endpoint/BMC/OS health. Never infer the path from all-bus scans, manipulate a live cable, probe unknown endpoints, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: No current executable PASS exists. Future PASS requires the exact harness/endpoints and every owner-required checkpoint to pass independently: expected logical devices/responses, correct physical PN/routing/seating/pinout, approved continuity values and/or signal waveform/timing margins, with no endpoint or platform health change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. A downstream address alone cannot PASS the cable. Missing harness/coverage definition, absent checkpoint, wrong endpoint, response mismatch, physical/pinout defect, continuity or signal threshold failure, incomplete evidence or endpoint/platform anomaly is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict. One modality cannot silently substitute for another.
safety_gate: Do not scan all buses to infer cable topology or probe unknown devices behind a harness.
Do not unplug, reseat, continuity-test or instrument a live cable without an approved power/isolation state and human procedure.
Keep logical, visual, continuity and signal-integrity evidence and verdicts separate.
Stop on any endpoint, management, power or bus anomaly; preserve evidence and do not retry/reset automatically.
expected_evidence: Qualified-human physical assembly/retention evidence when required
Instrument identity/calibration and complete continuity or waveform/timing/margin data when required
Pre/post endpoint, BMC SEL/SDR and OS health plus abort/no-retry/recovery and per-checkpoint owner verdict
test_case.recovery: No action is authorized now. The approved contract must define an isolated safe state and independent endpoint/platform recovery. On any anomaly, stop and preserve evidence without retry. Cable reseat, bus reset, reboot or power action is human/owner-controlled and requires explicit separate authorization.
